subject: Onramp: gating criteria & DPA redlines for FinVault evaluation
messages:
From: Elaine Mu <elaine.mu@finvault.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Park <tom.park@finvault.com>, procurement@finvault.com
Date: 2028-05-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security gates & MAP for evaluation

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at FinVault is excited to move into an evaluation MAP. Before we kick off, our procurement and security committees have asked for a clear list of acceptance gates and timelines. The items they care most about: latest SOC 2 Type II report, SIG/CAIQ summary for hosted vs private options, the DPA with any carve-outs/redlines, and confirmation of configurable data retention windows (especially for EU data).

We have an internal procurement cutoff for next Thursday (May 26) where we need to present any redlines to the DPA + a proposed close timeline. Can you share a MAP that includes security/compliance milestones and target dates? A short checklist with owners would be ideal.

Appreciate it —
Elaine
Elaine Mu
Head of IT Risk, FinVault
[Attachment: FinVault-Eval-Requirements.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Mu <elaine.mu@finvault.com>
Cc: Tom Park <tom.park@finvault.com>
Date: 2028-05-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security gates & MAP for evaluation

Hi Elaine —

Thanks — I attached a concise MAP skeleton below and included the items you enumerated. High level proposal:

- Week 0 (May 22–24): Evidence intake — we provide SOC 2 Type II report (summary + full report under NDA), CAIQ answers, and a draft DPA redline. Owner: Redwood legal + security (Ben).
- Week 1 (May 25–31): Procurement review & DPA negotiation. Target: DPA redline agreed or narrowed to < 3 open clauses. Owner: FinVault procurement + Redwood legal.
- Week 2 (Jun 1–7): Technical eval + data residency verification (staging access, EU residency if needed). Owner: FinVault engineers + Redwood infra.
- Week 3 (Jun 8–14): Acceptance run — acceptance criteria: SOC2 report OK, SIG answers reviewed, DPA signed or escalation path documented, retention window documented.

Quick asks from our side to hit your May 26 procurement cutoff: please confirm whether FinVault requires EU-only storage for the evaluation and whether procurement will accept our standard DPA with the listed redlines (I attached a draft). If you confirm EU residency, we’ll prioritize the private deploy checklist.

Attachments I included: SOC2 summary, SIG/CAIQ answer set, DPA redline (draft).

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Principal Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2-TypeII-Report-2027.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: SIG-CAIQ-summary-answers.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: Redline-DPA-FinVault-20280524.docx (docx)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-22T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Security gates & MAP for evaluation — need legal + security input

Ben / Marissa — forwarding FinVault's ask. Procurement needs DPA redline visibility by Thurs 5/26. Can Ben confirm whether we can commit to providing a clean DPA redline by EOD 5/24 and whether security can provide a concise EU-residency confirmation (staging + eval infra) by EOD 5/23?

Excerpt from Elaine: "our procurement cutoff for next Thursday (May 26) where we need to present any redlines to the DPA + a proposed close timeline."

If we can commit, I'll push the MAP to them as-is. If not, we need an escalation path.

Thanks —
Sofia

> On 2028-05-22 09:12, Elaine Mu wrote:
> > Thanks again for the demo last week...

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-22T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Security gates & MAP for evaluation — need legal + security input

Quick note — we can deliver the DPA redline by COB 5/24. I'll attach a short legal memo outlining the meaningful concessions we typically accept and those we can't.

On retention: standard retention tiers we propose for evaluations are 30 / 90 / 365 days (configurable per-account), with EU tenant residency available on request (we'll enable a private eval pool if customer requires). Security will provide the EU staging confirmation by tomorrow (5/23).

I'll also include a one-page SOC2 summary (controls in-scope) for procurement decks.

Ben Carter
Head of Growth — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Legal-Memo-DPA-Concessions-1p.pdf (pdf)]

From: Elaine Mu <elaine.mu@finvault.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Park <tom.park@finvault.com>, procurement@finvault.com
Date: 2028-05-23T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security gates & MAP for evaluation

Thanks — that's helpful. A couple clarifications:

1) Procurement will want to surface any non-standard clauses (esp. data transfer / subprocessor notifications) at the committee on Thu 5/26. If you can mark "hard no" vs "negotiable" in the redline draft, that will speed review.
2) For SIG/CAIQ, can you highlight answers that map to our in-scope requirements (network segmentation, key management, access logs)?
3) EU residency: yes, we require EU-only storage for PII used in the evaluation. Please confirm the timeline to spin up a private eval pool and whether that affects the DPA language (subprocessor/subcontractor visibility).

If you can get the redline by 5/24 and a short note on EU pool lead time, procurement should be able to present on 5/26.

Best,
Elaine

> On May 22, 2028, at 10:03 AM, Sofia Ivanova wrote:
> > Hi Elaine —
> > Thanks — I attached a concise MAP skeleton...

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Mu <elaine.mu@finvault.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tom Park <tom.park@finvault.com>
Date: 2028-05-25T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security gates & MAP for evaluation — finalized acceptance checklist

Elaine / Tom —

Thanks for the clarifications. Consolidating and confirming commitments so procurement has a clean slide on 5/26: 

- Deliverables Redwood will provide by 2028-05-24 (owner: Redwood legal/security):
  * DPA redline (document attached) — clauses marked HARD/NEGOTIABLE in comments.
  * SOC 2 Type II: summary + full report available under NDA (summary attached).
  * SIG/CAIQ: annotated answers with highlights for network segmentation, key mgmt, and access logging.
- EU-only evaluation pool: we can instantiate a private eval pool. Lead time: 48 hours from confirmation (owner: Redwood infra). This will be configured for EU residency and isolated subprocessors.
- Retention windows for evaluation: 30 / 90 / 365 days supported; default 30 days unless FinVault requests otherwise in writing.
- Acceptance criteria for procurement deck: SOC2 summary aligns with controls; SIG highlights cover in-scope items; DPA redline has at most 3 outstanding negotiable clauses.
- Next steps: Redwood to send the final redline + SIG annotations by COB 5/24. FinVault to confirm EU pool request by 5/24 10:00am (so we can spin up by 5/26).

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-Report-2027.pdf (summary), SIG-CAIQ-summary-answers.xlsx (annotated), Redline-DPA-FinVault-20280524.docx (redline). HubSpot deal updated with MAP and milestones.

If anything changes, please flag and I'll escalate to legal/CS.

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Principal Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2-TypeII-Report-2027.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: SIG-CAIQ-summary-answers.xlsx (xlsx)]
